question: How many annual leave days do full-time employees receive?

retrieved_chunks.text:
1 Annual Leave
Full-time employees receive 20 working days of paid annual leave each calendar year. Requests must be submitted in the leave system at least five working days before the first day of leave.

3 Carry Forward
Up to five unused annual leave days may be carried into the next calendar year with manager approval.

2 Sick Leave
Employees may take up to 10 paid sick days each calendar year. A medical certificate is required when an absence lasts three consecutive working days or more.

1 Eligibility
Eligible employees may work remotely up to two days each week with manager approval. Employees must record their remote-work schedule in the team calendar.

1 First Week
New employees must complete security awareness training and acknowledge the acceptable-use policy within their first five working days.

2 Expenses
Original itemized receipts are required for expenses above 25 USD. Expense claims must be submitted within 30 days after travel ends.

2 Public Networks
Employees using public Wi-Fi must connect through the company VPN before accessing company systems or data.

3 Incident Reporting
Suspected security incidents must be reported to the Security Team immediately through the incident portal.

1 Passwords
Employees must use unique passwords and multi-factor authentication for company systems. Passwords must not be shared with any person.

1 Travel Approval
Employees must obtain manager approval before booking business travel. International travel also requires department-head approval.
